data.name: Asharvi
data.gender_notes: Asharvi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Asha’, meaning ‘hope’ or ‘wish’. Asharvi represents the blessing of Goddess Asha, who is the embodiment of hope and desire. In Hindu mythology, Asha is believed to bestow happiness, prosperity, and fulfillment upon her devotees. The name Asharvi carries the meaning “Goddess Asha's Blessing” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Asharvi usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess asha's blessing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodying the spirit of hope and aspiration
